description: Active automatic (no coupon) Percent Off Brand promotion on the store and profile, with the active brand it discounts; link the test's product to its brand output. KB: Configuring a Promotion (Percent Off Brand); Brands.

discountAmount.description: Optional percent the promotion takes off, when the test asserts a fixed percent; left out = any (read it from the record)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

profile.description: Profile code the promotion must apply to: the declared user's profile, or the store's default anonymous profile for guest steps

now.description: System param: evaluation time, filled in by the profiler or resolver; tests do not set it
